faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Goa (NIT Goa) for a project-based research position under the NISAR Utilization Programme of ISRO, GOI.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIT Goa?
faq.answer: NIT Goa has advertised for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under advertisement number NITG/NISAR/Manpower/2026/OW/02.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for NIT Goa JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 15 October 2026. Candidates must complete submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech, B.E., M.Tech., M.E., or equivalent in the relevant discipline with NET/GATE and at least 6.5 CGPA or 60% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus 20% HRA along with other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for NIT Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the form and submit soft copies via the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form for this research fellowship position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on merit and project requirements, followed by a written test and/or personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website of NIT Goa?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the National Institute of Technology Goa at http://www.nitgoa.ac.in for further announcements and updates.
